item.title: Amundi Sees Buying Opportunity If French Bond Ructions Resume
item.description: France’s Amundi SA said a renewed selloff in the nation’s beaten-down bonds could create buying opportunities.

item.title: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
item.description: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff fueled by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.

item.title: South Africa Port Operator Blames Delays on Old Equipment
item.description: The operator of South Africa’s biggest shipping container terminal blamed poor equipment upkeep for severe delays that have caused medical supply shortages and hit car exports, triggering threats it could lose its license.

item.title: Algebris Hedges Against AT1 Volatility by Avoiding Tight Spreads
item.description: Algebris Investments is taking a cautious approach to AT1 bonds as spreads remain historically tight, avoiding the most expensive parts of the market and keeping buffers against a potential downturn. Other investors remain positive on the asset class, arguing that banks are well capitalized and that even French lenders remain fundamentally sound despite political and sovereign-market volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Alphabet to Raise at Least $3.5 Billion With Canadian Debt Sale
item.description: Alphabet Inc. is returning to the Canadian market with a five-part bond sale, just six months after issuing its first notes in the currency.
